sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Sustained harmonic horizontal lines starting about 0.2 s after the event, which reads as a musical phrase onset, not a transient SFX.

pattern.description: Live-action meeting shot with a static frosted 'AI Agents' card ('Send notification to client', Approve button) composited top-right; within this burst only the actors move (head turns and a hand with a phone entering from the right). The card does not animate.
pattern.why_premium: The UI card is tracked onto real footage as a soft frosted-glass overlay, so the product sits inside the story rather than cutting away to a screen recording.

build_hint.gsap: Footage layer plays untouched; the overlay card is static in this burst. If building the card entrance elsewhere: gsap.fromTo(card, {opacity: 0, y: 16, scale: 0.97, filter: 'blur(6px)'}, {opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)', duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: <OffthreadVideo> base with an absolutely positioned card: backdropFilter blur and a semi-transparent white fill; for its entrance use spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}) driving opacity and translateY 16 to 0.

notes: The motion in this event is all live action; the 'AI Agents' overlay card is identical across every filmstrip frame, so it is not listed. b01 is a union box covering both people.
